method: Distinct comparator-only package/version/CVE tuples; explicit release evidence only, matched by binary package then installed source package and source version.

classes.not_in_inventory: Package or exact version not identified in the VV inventory
classes.not_in_historical_tracker: CVE absent from the historical CVE/list
classes.no_release_evidence: CVE and source package present in historical list, but no bullseye-specific status or advisory fix
classes.no_source_package_evidence: CVE present historically but no matching source package line
classes.historical_unbounded: Historical release-specific observation has no version bound or otherwise remains indeterminate
classes.historical_not_affected: Historical release status explicitly not affected
classes.historical_fixed_at_or_before_installed: Historical release fixed threshold at or before installed source version
classes.historical_affected_not_matched: Historical release fixed threshold above installed source version, but no matching VV tuple
classes.historical_other: Historical release record cannot be classified safely
